focus: D1/D2 Correctness and security — corpus checker, DESIGN.md applicator and its gates

findingDetails.title: The design-md gate list in color-system.md names three gates the design-md path does not apply
findingDetails.evidence: The sentence claims rampDarkestOnSurface and rampLightestOnSurface apply to the two series ends and rampStepSeparation to adjacent series values. apply-design-md.cjs validateTheme (:469-482) applies only textOnSurface, markOnSurface and emphasisAgainstFirstSeries; check-corpus.cjs checkDesignMdBlock (:526-641) applies the same set and compares all six series pairs with a separation-or-30-degree-hue disjunction (:588-596); the code comment at :586-591 states the ramp gates are deliberately not applied. design-md-theming.md:128-133 already states the true set, so the two reference documents contradict each other.
findingDetails.recommendation: Correct color-system.md:307-310 to the set design-md-theming.md:128-133 carries, or implement the ramp gates in validateTheme and checkDesignMdBlock. Do not leave the two documents disagreeing.

findingDetails.title: Catalog family column carries two values the same document does not define and no check reads the column
findingDetails.evidence: funnel names part-to-whole and dumbbell names change; catalog.md:81 defines the cell as the question group from section 4, and section 4 (:112-119) defines six families. Extraction over the sentinel block gives 9 time, 5 composition, 5 comparison, 4 distribution, 3 relationship, 1 matrix, 1 part-to-whole, 1 change = 29 rows. parseCatalog (check-corpus.cjs:2541-2579) reads id, file and system only; checkCatalogSystem (:2616-2644) gates the system cell alone.
findingDetails.recommendation: Re-label the two rows into the six defined families or add the two names to section 4, and extend the catalog families to hold the family cell against the section 4 list the way catalog-system holds the system cell.

findingDetails.title: The immutable-stock-forms guard compares paths lexically
findingDetails.evidence: path.resolve normalises .. but not symlinks, and the prefix test is case-sensitive while the default macOS volume is not, so a symlink to assets/templates or a differently-cased spelling passes the guard and mkdirSync/writeFileSync (:670-672) then overwrite stock forms. The guard is the only protection for the files template-contract.md:385 calls immutable.
findingDetails.recommendation: Compare fs.realpathSync of the nearest existing ancestor against fs.realpathSync(TEMPLATE_DIR) and refuse on containment rather than a lexical prefix.

findingDetails.title: references/README.md says three reference files and ships four
findingDetails.evidence: Line 24 reads 'Three files sit here'; the table at :26-31 lists four (catalog.md, color-system.md, design-md-theming.md, template-contract.md) and the lede at :22 already says the set answers four questions.

reason: ratio above threshold; stopPolicy is max-iterations so the cap governs the stop and iteration 2 broadens review angles rather than synthesizing early
